title: Elige el mundo visual de SIWAT
question: La tirada asignó «Folio y sello». Quédate con ella, toma una alternativa o vuelve a tirar.

options.label: Folio y sello
options.lineage: Salvadoran notarial folios and institutional rubber stamps (FGR, juzgados, alcaldías)
options.thesis: Your case gets the weight of a stamped legal record: every answer is a numbered folio, the verdict lands as an inked stamp.
options.viewport: Plum top bar with SIWAT and SALIR RÁPIDO; a paper folio card numbered «Folio 01/03» holds the question; the coral action sits at the thumb. On the result, the semáforo verdict is pressed onto the folio as a coloured stamp carrying the case code SIWAT-2026-XXXX and the UTC time.
options.risk: Can read bureaucratic and cold if the stamps are timid or the copy loses its warmth.

raised.raise: Each verdict stamp has its own shape (octagon red, triangle yellow, circle green) so the light reads without colour.
«Limpiar datos de este dispositivo» is isolated by deliberate empty space and a confirmation, never next to the download.
Severity is one fixed ramp (green < yellow < red) used identically on banner, legal cards and PDF.
Each step owns one decision per screen section; nothing competes with the current question.

options.label: Añil
options.thesis: «Dale color a lo que otros invisibilizan» made literal: the result dyes the screen like cloth in the vat.
options.viewport: Deep indigo-plum header band with a dyed stripe; questions on pale cloth-white; the result floods the top half with the semáforo colour as a dye field.
options.risk: Familiar warm-crafts territory; the dye field can feel decorative rather than legal.

options.label: Exposure record
options.case: Fuses poorly: activists do not identify with darkroom printing; hatching obscures urgent copy.

options.label: Developer console
options.case: Fuses poorly: a tool for coders, foreign to the audience; dark graphite feels threatening in crisis.
options.kept: Destructive actions isolated by empty space.

options.label: Star atlas
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to political violence or law.

options.label: Vertical video feed
options.case: Fuses poorly: mimics the very platforms where the aggression happens.
options.kept: One thing owns the screen at a time.

options.label: Zoo guide map
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful leisure register is wrong for a crisis tool.

options.label: Crouwel grid specimen
options.case: Fuses poorly: monumental type hurts readability under stress.

canonCard.label: El estándar de la categoría
canonCard.thesis: A clean mobile safety app: white cards, plum header, coral buttons, coloured result banner.
canonCard.viewport: Plum app bar, white rounded cards stacked, coral full-width button.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other NGO app; forgettable in a judged hackathon.
